page.overview:
Who is Funeral Guests?

The Funeral Guests are a group of Candy People who appear in "James Baxter the Horse." They presumably knew the ghost before he died, as they are seen attending his funeral. Finn and Jake try to cheer them up several times throughout the episode, failing until their final attempt. This angers the ghost, however, who attacks Finn and Jake, prompting the funeral guests to flee.

They look like generic Candy People. They wear black funereal clothes. They resemble Candy gum drops.
